title: sail journal line: one completed call or step
description: One NDJSON line in journal.ndjson: the append-only record a resume replays from. One line per completed call, per completed intake, and per step inside a multi-step stage. A call of a group carries the group's keys, and a call line and its step lines may carry a short hash per binding the workflow supplied.

reason.description: why the call didn't produce what was asked: the agent's reason when blocked, its errors when error; null otherwise

group.description: the keys of the group this call belongs to, in declaration order

bindings.description: one short hash per value or file binding the workflow supplied to this call, or to the call this step belongs to, by binding name: what the determinism guard compares on replay. Absent on a line written without them.
